author: CNET
description:
Mostly same same, but a little bit different. 💻🖥️

On the heels of Apple’s new iPad Mini, Apple has turned its attention to its Mac lineup. Unlike the iPad Mini that received an OLED display and a water-resistant design, today’s Mac updates are mere spec bumps.

But Apple’s Pro and Tell week isn’t over. It will culminate with tomorrow’s special event in Los Angeles, where Apple is expected to reveal the long-awaited touchscreen MacBook Pro.

CNET Senior Editor Matt Elliott is here to run through what you need to know about this M6 Mac update. #apple #m6imac #firstlook #proandtell #m6macbookpro
title: Apple Brings M6 Updates to MacBook Pro and iMac Lines
